archi2-2:9b.name: Archi2
archi2-2:9b.description: archi2 is an 9B parameter language model fine-tuned on top of Ministral-8B, trained on a limited and curated dataset up to May 2024. It is optimized for raw logical reasoning, structured brainstorming, and high-quality human language expressiveness.
capabilities: Processing large documents and long-context tasks
Search and retrieval with context and filtering (truth and relevance)
limitations: Real-time API or database integration (model is not designed for tool-augmented pipelines)
Advanced search and retrieval that requires up-to-date information or dynamic data sources
